items.title: Give consent to the rent increase (§ 558b BGB)
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie mir die beigefügte Zustimmungserklärung unterschrieben zurück.
items.computation: The letter itself confirms delivery: 'Diesen Brief hat mein Sohn am 18. November 2026 um 10:30 Uhr bei Ihnen eingeworfen.' Hand-delivery during normal daytime hours means receipt (Zugang) on the same day: 18.11.2026 (a Tuesday, in the month of November 2026). Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB, the tenant must consent 'bis zum Ablauf des zweiten Kalendermonats nach Empfang des Erhöhungsverlangens.' Counting calendar months after the month of receipt (November): 1st = December 2026, 2nd = January 2027. The period therefore ends at the close of January 2027, i.e. 31.01.2027. That day is a Sunday; under § 193 BGB a deadline for a declaration that falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday moves to the next business day, which is Monday 01.02.2027 (not a Hessen public holiday). If the tenant does not consent by then, the landlord may sue for consent (Zustimmungsklage) within a further three months.

items.title: Increased net cold rent (545,00 €) takes effect
items.quote:
Ich bitte Sie, der Erhöhung Ihrer Nettokaltmiete von 480,00 € auf 545,00 € (7,90 € je m² bei 69 m²)
ab dem 01.02.2027 zuzustimmen.
items.computation: The letter fixes the requested effective date of the higher rent explicitly as 01.02.2027. This matches § 558b Abs. 1 BGB, under which the increased rent is owed 'von Beginn des dritten Kalendermonats nach Zugang des Erhöhungsverlangens an': receipt on 18.11.2026 (November) → 1st following month December, 2nd January, 3rd February 2027, so the earliest the increase could legally start is 01.02.2027, consistent with the date stated in the letter.
